## Choose a physics course {#choose}

Every lesson belongs to one physics course. Each course teaches by three
activities: **construct** the physics as a program you can run and check,
**investigate** it against measurements and with experiments that an AI agent
helps to run, and **verify** the result, by tests, by independent checks, or by
a machine-checked proof in Lean. Open a course below to see its lessons in
teaching order, each with one preview and its level. Each lesson names the
lessons it builds on and says what you will be able to do after it. Read a
course from its first lesson, follow one method across courses, or start with
any lesson whose prerequisites you have.

This page is generated from the lessons when the site is built. A course
appears once it has a lesson, and a planned lesson is shown as planned.
Methods and paths further down list the same lessons as links.
